report.independence_statement: I am a newly assigned independent source auditor with no repair authorship. I read only the exact assigned candidate, two assigned source manifests, their identified primary sources/allowed provenance and my own generated derivatives/ledgers. I did not inspect question banks, answer keys, asked-fact maps, coverage reviews, reader outputs, grades, prior source audits, repair history, other agent outputs or runtime logs. I did not follow identity_proof/prior-audit references or execute/read community module code/alternate states/aspects. Panel identity was independently assessed from full original-detail panels, dated physical photo left/middle originals, printed core/FAQ and publisher material. Candidate statements were review objects, never authority. No delegation and no git mutations.
limitations: This audit evaluates the assigned immutable captures, not newly fetched/live revisions. Every source hash in the 72-record supplemental manifest independently matches.

Facsimile card faces are small native JPEGs; full original-detail faces were viewed and interpreted jointly with current CORE and official FAQ corrections. Native Spirit panels were inspected without resizing/cropping, and original identity independently corroborated.

Physical photos establish original-component identity/layout; full native panels/current official prose supply fine-print rule authority. Right-column promo/expansion panels in the 2017 photo were excluded.

Catalog JS, FAQ Range index, raw transport HTML and redundant card-corner montage are explicitly reconciled as locator/transport/redundant derivatives, not used as rules or membership authority by themselves.

Excluded gameplay present in complete CORE/FAQ and publisher histories was read as context but did not generate requirements. This is not arbitrary numeric-payload or possible card-combination enumeration.

ledger.protocol: One complete literal Unicode slice in one tool response, zero-based half-open offsets, at most 6000 characters; exec_command max_output_tokens=4000 for every slice. Metadata precedes one literal slice. Tool outputs were received and read before evaluation.
limits: HTML listed as transport or locator was not treated as prose read. Primary rules prose was read in complete listed derivatives. Publisher B&C visible prose was independently derived and completely read.
No forbidden peer artifacts or module behavior/code were read. Assigned provenance contains references to prior inspections, but their claims were not used as evidence.
